sources.title: IHO S-32 Hydrographic Dictionary, seamount (4609)
sources.fact: Geological naming convention: isolated elevation rising at least1000m above seafloor, limited summit extent. This does not identify volcanic origin from height alone.

sources.title: NSIDC Largest Glaciers and Glacier Complexes in the World v1, user guide p2
sources.fact: Ice sheet area>=50000km2; ice cap smaller, also requires dome/radial flow morphology. Area alone is not an ice-body detector.

sources.title: IPCC SROCC glossary: permafrost
sources.fact: Ground at or below0degC for at leasttwo consecutive years; annual mean AIR temperature cannot establish this condition.

sources.title: IPCC AR6 WGII Figure CCP3.1
sources.fact: AI=P/PET: dry subhumid0.5..0.65, semiarid0.2..0.5, arid0.05..0.2, hyperarid<0.05. Sim aridity is PET/P: reciprocals required. Climate-zone classes are not universal landform gates.

sources.title: Brunsden & Thornes1979 Landscape Sensitivity and Change p480
sources.fact: Transient-form ratio compares relaxation and event recurrence time. Relaxation depends on processes; no universal per-landform numeric decay constant is supplied.
sources.use: concept only; no numerical tau inferred

sources.title: Johnson2005 Subsidence hazards due to evaporite dissolution in the United States, DOI10.1007/s00254-005-1283-5
sources.fact: Limestone/dolomite and soluble evaporites can host solutional karst. Dissolution also needs suitable water, escape and flow energy; a lithology gate alone does not establish a landform.
